label: Official Authority
definition: Government regulator, statutory authority or official food-safety body.

label: Public Broadcaster
definition: Publicly funded national broadcaster or newsroom.

label: Commercial News Publisher
definition: Commercial national newsroom or publisher.

label: Consumer Organisation
definition: Consumer testing, advocacy or product-investigation body.

label: Specialist Evidence Organisation
definition: Specialist evidence-led organisation producing reporting, investigation or analysis using identifiable sources or disclosed methods.

label: Food Recall Registry
definition: Official consumer-facing product recall and withdrawal notices.

label: Regulatory & Enforcement Reporting
definition: Official proceedings, findings, warnings, undertakings and enforcement outcomes.

label: National Mainstream Reporting
definition: National reporting capable of recurring named product, brand or company coverage.

label: Dedicated Investigative & Verification Journalism
definition: Original investigation, testing, documents, fieldwork or verification.

label: Consumer Testing & Advocacy
definition: Product testing, comparison and consumer-focused investigation.

label: Specialist Evidence & Watchdog Investigation
definition: Evidence-led specialist reporting or investigation using identifiable sources or disclosed methods.

label: Food Safety
definition: Official food recalls, allergen or food-safety notices, withdrawal notices, and equivalent approved food-safety reporting concerning a product or identifiable product range.

label: In the News
definition: Approved current reporting, investigation, or non-food-safety regulator/enforcement developments about a product, brand or company.

label: Australia
definition: Market-specific delivery scope. Use where founders expressly restrict the Signal to Australia; FSANZ food recalls are AU by default.

label: New Zealand
definition: Market-specific delivery scope. Use where founders expressly restrict the Signal to New Zealand; MPI/New Zealand Food Safety recalls are NZ by default.

label: Australia and New Zealand
definition: Default eligible delivery market for In the News Signals unless founders expressly narrow the market. Source/event geography is qualified in the Signal copy and does not itself limit firing. Food recalls remain authority-market-specific: FSANZ → AU; MPI/New Zealand Food Safety → NZ.

label: Active
definition: Authorised source channel.

label: Inactive
definition: Retained identifier but not authorised for new Signal records.

label: Confirmed
definition: Highest evidence and identity confidence.

label: Strong
definition: Strong evidence and defensible identity/scope.

label: Probable
definition: Insufficient for public publication.

label: Low
definition: Insufficient for public publication.

label: Rejected
definition: Rejected evidence or resolution.

label: Seeded
definition: Initial governed data row awaiting review.

label: Provisional
definition: Reviewed in part but not final.

label: Reviewed
definition: Governed review complete.

label: Disputed
definition: Material challenge or conflict under review.

label: Archived
definition: No longer active; retained for history.

label: Candidate
definition: Ingested or drafted; not public.

label: Held for Review
definition: Awaiting required review or resolution.

label: Publishable
definition: All class, scope, review and resolution gates pass.

label: Suppressed
definition: Not eligible for public display.

label: Expired
definition: Past the approved public display horizon.

label: Resolved
definition: Canonical target resolved without material warning.

label: Resolved with Warning
definition: Target resolved with an approved qualification.

label: Ambiguous
definition: Multiple plausible targets or unresolved scope conflict.

label: Blocked
definition: Must not become publishable.

label: Needs Review
definition: Must remain candidate or held for review.

label: Product
definition: A bounded reviewed product or product line. In an allowed market, relevance is established by either an exact match to a verified GTIN governed on the Signal target, or by resolved Chaining brand/entity identity plus a founder-reviewed product-name term. GTIN is positive-only evidence and is not stored in Chaining.

label: Product Family
definition: Historical value only for MVP. Product-family determination is de-scoped; no current publishable MVP target may depend on product_family.

label: Brand
definition: A canonical brand or sub-brand governed in Chaining. Current MVP brand targets use a canonical B-ID with brand_descendants propagation; product/GTIN facts are not stored in Chaining.

label: Entity
definition: A canonical current entity governed in Chaining. Current MVP entity targets use a canonical P-ID with entity_descendants propagation.

label: Operational Entity
definition: A governed manufacturer, importer, distributor, licensee or other selected operator used where operational scope is the approved basis; resolve through the existing Chaining operational relationship.

label: Not Applicable
definition: Used where a subject response is not relevant, typically official recall records.

label: Pending Review
definition: The source may contain a response, but it has not yet been captured and reviewed.

label: Captured from Source
definition: The approved source itself contains the subject/company response.

label: Captured from Separate Public Statement
definition: A separate public statement from the subject/company is linked and summarised.

label: Not Reported
definition: No subject response is reported in the approved source; this is not treated as a refusal to comment.

label: Declined to Comment
definition: The source explicitly reports that the subject declined to comment or respond.

label: Exact Only
definition: Do not propagate beyond the bounded product scope defined by the target. A verified GTIN or reviewed product-name match may establish relevance. Pack size, batch/date, retailer and similar source qualifications do not create additional MVP firing gates unless expressly founder-approved.

label: Family Members
definition: Historical value only for MVP. Family-members propagation is de-scoped and must not be used by a current publishable MVP target.

label: Brand Descendants
definition: Match products resolving through Chaining to the canonical brand or its governed child-brand descendants. Chaining remains brand/entity ownership and alias governance only.

label: Entity Descendants
definition: Match current product/brand descendants whose governed Chaining ownership path resolves to the canonical entity.

label: Operational Descendants
definition: Match reviewed products linked to the selected operational entity where that relationship is the approved scope basis.

label: Cocoa / Chocolate
definition: Optional additional narrowing after the base brand/entity target matches. Pass only where available product evidence positively indicates cocoa or chocolate relevance; otherwise fail closed. This is the only approved MVP product-scope guard.

label: Product Match Terms
definition: Pipe-separated founder-reviewed positive product-name phrases for a product target. Terms are alternatives (OR). Name matching is used only with the governed Chaining identity path; failure to match does not veto a verified GTIN match.

label: Verified GTINs
definition: Pipe-separated founder-reviewed exact GTINs stored in the Dynamic Signals asset as positive-only product evidence. A matching GTIN may establish product relevance even where crowdsourced product/brand text is poor. Missing or non-matching GTINs do not veto a valid identity + product-name match.

label: Scope Review Summary
definition: Internal targeting governance: why the target type, propagation and optional guard are correct and what the Signal must not propagate to. It is not consumer copy and must not silently introduce pack/date/batch gates.

label: Scope Qualification
definition: Consumer-facing qualification of the source/event scope, including affected packs, batches, dates, retailer or geography where relevant. It informs the consumer but does not become a runtime firing rule unless founders expressly approve that gate.

label: Verified GTIN Evidence
definition: Compact provenance for GTINs promoted into verified_gtins. Each governed GTIN should retain at least one product-code source URL; corroborating evidence may be included. Candidate or rejected GTINs do not enter the runtime verified_gtins list.
